newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Bradesco Q1 net rises vs yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Bradesco Q1 net rises vs yr ago.

text.p: Leading private Brazilian retail bank Banco Bradesco released the following consolidated first-quarter 1997 results.
Note: All figures are in Brazilian reais and are not adjusted for inflation.
Figures for share net are per lot of 1,000 shares.
According to its quarterly financial statement, the bank's net worth in the period reached 5.634 billion reais or 5.94 reais per 1,000 shares, for a return over net worth of 15.13 percent.
No comparative net worth figures for the three-month period last year were provided.
The bank also reported total assets in the period of 39.24 billion reais but did not give figures for last year.
